limitations: Figures are client-observed. Remote backends include network time.
Tail percentiles with small N describe this sample. They are not a stable service-level objective.
Output tokens are streamed pieces as delivered, not retokenized with a local tokenizer.
Warmup requests are stored in requests.jsonl and excluded from summary statistics.
Load is closed-loop: at most `concurrency` requests are in flight. This is not an open-loop arrival process.
The reference transformers server serializes generation. Concurrency measures that queue plus compute, not a production scheduler.
VRAM is reported only when the server process can read it.

definitions.ttft_ms: Time from request issue to the first streamed token, observed by this client. The clock starts after a concurrency slot is acquired.
definitions.itl_ms: Gaps between consecutive streamed tokens, pooled across successful measured requests. The first token is TTFT and is not an inter-token gap. Requests with one token contribute no inter-token samples.
definitions.e2e_ms: Time from request issue until the client observes stream completion, including the last token.
definitions.requests_per_sec: Successful measured requests divided by the measurement window in seconds. Failed requests are excluded from the numerator and included in the window when they occupied a concurrency slot.
definitions.output_tokens_per_sec: Streamed token pieces from successful measured requests, divided by the measurement window in seconds.
definitions.mean_decode_tokens_per_sec: Mean, over successful requests with at least two tokens, of (output_tokens - 1) / (time from the first token to the last token).
definitions.measurement_window_s: On the run clock, earliest measured request issue to latest measured request finish at that concurrency level. Warmup is outside the window. The load pattern is closed-loop: at most `concurrency` requests are in flight, and a new request starts when a slot frees. Client-side queue delay is not part of latency. Queueing inside the server still appears in TTFT.
definitions.output_tokens: Count of non-empty streamed pieces delivered to the client. This follows the provider's stream tokenization and is not a local retokenization.
definitions.error_rate: Failed measured requests, including timeouts, divided by measured requests issued. Warmup failures are stored and reported separately and are not in this rate.
definitions.percentile_method: Hyndman-Fan type 7: linear interpolation between the two nearest ranks. This matches NumPy's default percentile. With a small N, p95 and p99 describe this sample only.
